comment: How many search term recommendations to show.
modal: The number of alternative search-term recommendations shown for a query. Applies only when search recommendations are enabled. Can differ per store view.

comment: Whether to show the number of results next to each search recommendation.
modal: When **Yes**, each search recommendation displays how many results it would return. Applies only when search recommendations are enabled. Can differ per store view.

comment: How many search suggestions to show.
modal: The number of search suggestions offered for a query. Applies only when search suggestions are enabled. Can differ per store view.
